facts.text: I am looking to explore more online courses in data science and machine learning to improve my skills.
I have already completed a few online courses in data science and machine learning.
I have a Master's degree in Business Administration from the University of Michigan.
I am interested in the Data Science for Business course on Coursera.
I want to know the duration, level of difficulty, and prerequisites for the Data Science for Business course.
I am interested in learning more about the case studies used in the Data Science for Business course.
I want to know whether the case studies are based on real-world companies or industries.
I want to know whether the case studies are relevant to my experience in management consulting.
I am interested in learning more about the instructors Professors Galit Shmueli and Peter Bruce.
I want to learn about the backgrounds and expertise of Professors Galit Shmueli and Peter Bruce.
I am confident that the instructors' teaching approach and industry experience will help me develop practical skills in data science and business analytics.
I want to learn how the course will help me apply data science concepts to my current role as a management consultant.
I want the course to help me bridge the gap between data analysis and business decision-making.
I want the course to help me develop a business-focused mindset.
I want the course to help me create business value through data-driven insights and recommendations.
